name: SRNO3D Query RGB
definition: Samples feature maps at query coordinates using a 2x2x2 grid of offsets, weights samples by the relative volume of each sub-cell, and combines them with a residual from bilinear upsampling of the input.
summary: SRNO3D Query RGB is a volume-aware feature aggregation method that weights eight corner samples by sub-cell volume to reduce aliasing and improve reconstruction quality in neural radiance fields.
